product.name: Chimsoc High Temperature Rubber Pipe Flashing - Red SILICONE - 5-55mm Diameter - CF2HTR
product.description:
Base dimensions:- 135mm x 135mm
Suits Pipe Diameters:- 5mm to 55mm (1/4" to 2 1/8")
Suits Roof Pitches:- 0-40 degrees
Temperature Range:- -50 to +225 Degrees C, and up to 260 Degrees C intermittently.

Chimsoc Pipe Flashings, available in Red, Grey and Black High Temperature Silicone, are a top quality solution for sealing around pipes penetrating through roofs, providing a reliable and long-lasting weather resistant seal.

Designed to withstand temperatures up to 225°C continuous, and 260°C intermittently, Chimsoc Pipe Flashings are suitable for use on high temperature applications such as chimneys, exhaust vents, and flues. The red, grey and black coloured silicone material ensures a sleek and unobtrusive finish, making them an excellent choice for modern and traditional roofs alike.

Easy to install and highly flexible, Chimsoc High Temperature Pipe Flashings offer excellent resistance to UV, ozone, and weathering, making them a reliable and cost effective solution for your roofing needs.

HIGH TEMPERATURE RESISTANCE
Silicone rubber has a MUCH higher temperature resistance then EPDM rubber. Our silicone pipe flashings can be used from -50 to +225 Degrees C, and up to 260 Degrees C intermittently. It is recommended to use silicone pipe flashings for wood burning and multi fuel stove installations.

NOW IN BLACK AND GREY COLOURS
Traditionally high temperature silicone pipe flashings have been red in colour. We offer red, and uniquely also give the option of black and grey colours.

Suits Pipe Diameters:- 75mm to 200mm (3" to 8")
Base dimensions:- 605mm x 505mm
Suits Roof Pitches:- 20-45 degrees
Temperature Range:- -50 to +225 Degrees C, and up to 260 Degrees C intermittently.

CHIMSOC high temperature pitched tile pipe flashings are the solution for flashing pipes through tiled roofs. Manufactured using HIGH TEMPERATURE silicone rubber, with a flexible aluminium base to allow the pipe flashing base to be adjusted to suit almost any contour.

HIGH TEMPERATURE RESISTANCE
Silicone rubber has a MUCH higher temperature resistance then EPDM rubber. Our silicone pipe flashings can be used from -50 to +225 Degrees C, and up to 260 Degrees C intermittently. It is recommended to use silicone pipe flashings for wood burning and multi fuel stove installations.

Installation
1. Pull tab design to correct size using pliers, alternatively cut.
2. Apply silicone sealant to back of flashing.
3. Remove tiles around pipe and slide flashing over pipe.
4. Fasten flashing to the roof.
5. Cut tile to fit to the top of the flashing allowing the bottom of the flashing metal base to sit on top of the tiles.

product.name: Invena 1/2 Inch Inline Ball Valve Female Thread For Water With Drain Valve
product.description: A ball valve is a valve with a spherical disc, the part of the valve which controls the flow through it. The sphere has a hole, or port, through the middle so that when the port is in line with both ends of the valve, flow will occur. When the valve is closed, the hole is perpendicular to the ends of the valve, and flow is blocked. The handle or lever will be inline with the port position letting you "see" the valve's position. The ball valve, along with the butterfly valve and plug valve, are part of the family of quarter turn valves.  Ball valves are durable and usually work to achieve perfect shutoff even after years of disuse. They are therefore an excellent choice for shutoff applications (and are often preferred to globe valves and gate valves for this purpose). They do not offer the fine control that may be necessary in throttling applications but are sometimes used for this purpose. product.description:
Get your seeds off to a strong start with the Garland Small Budget Propagator, a practical and affordable solution for home seed germination. Maintaining the correct moisture level is essential for successful germination, and the drainage system helps protect delicate seedlings from excess water during their early stages of growth.

A lightweight clear vacuum-formed lid helps retain warmth and humidity around your seeds, creating a consistent environment that encourages quicker germination and stronger development. The transparent cover also allows plenty of natural light to reach your seedlings while making it easy to monitor progress without disturbing the growing conditions.

Manufactured in the UK, this compact propagator is ideal for windowsills, conservatories, greenhouses and other small growing spaces. Measuring 23cm long, 17cm wide and 12.5cm high, it is perfectly sized for raising a variety of seedlings while taking up minimal space.

Whether you are starting a vegetable garden, growing herbs indoors or raising bedding plants for the season ahead, the Garland Small Budget Propagator offers a simple, reliable and environmentally conscious way to achieve better germination results.

product.name: Hozelock 1583 Aquaforce 6000 Garden Pond Pump and Filter & 5m Hozelock Pond Hose
product.description:
Hozelock 1583 Aquaforce 6000 Garden Pond Pump and Filter

The Aquaforce 6000 is an extremely efficient filter and waterfall pump.
The Aquaforce case incorporates an exclusive wildlife protection system; protecting small fish, newts and frogs from accessing the pump.
The Wildlife Protection System reduces the risk of damage to common pond wildlife. For extra protection of species such as newts we recommend using an additional cage, available as a spare part.

Key Features:
Conical impeller - maximises performance
Self Cooling System - gives continuously perfect conditions
Ceramic Bearings - maximise pump life
Large cage surface area reduces cage clogging  improves water purity
Wildlife Protection System - protects small fish, newts, frogs, etc from accessing the pump
Carry handle - easy lifting in and out of the pond

How does Aquaforce work 

Pond water is drawn in through the cage grill which filters out coarse solids up to 6mm/10mm in size (dependent on model). Smaller particles down to 2mm in size can be eliminated by fitting the supplied clip-in fine mesh filter tray which affords the best possible protection for pond fish, preventing them from accessing the pump.

The Aquaforce has a considerably increased cage surface area, which allows the maximum amount of waste to be collected and pumped to the filter system. It also means that the cage is far less likely to clog, which will save you from constant cleaning.

Hozelock 5m Pond Hose

Made from high quality plastics this spiral hose is extremely flexible with a bend radius only 3 times its diameter without kinking or splitting.

product.name: Vinyl Bath Mat Runner Non Slip UV Resistant Cut-to-Size Underfloor Heating Yellow/White 50 x 60 cm
product.description:
Vinyl Bathroom Runner - Non-slip and Hard-wearing
The attractive bath mat made of a robust vinyl-polyester mix convinces with a resistant structure and its durability. Thanks to the slip-resistant PVC backing and the high dead weight, this bathroom floor covering always stays in the desired position and does not slip. Furthermore, the insensitive bathroom carpet has an impact sound-absorbing and dirt-repellent effect and is thus optimally suited for your bathroom furnishings. Thanks to its cold-insulating properties, this bath mat also protects you from an unpleasantly cold floor after a bath or shower. Of course, the bath mat can also be used in rooms with underfloor heating.
Individual design - many designs available
Discover our large selection of different sizes, colours and designs in the bathroom rugs and thus design your bathroom individually. Whether it's just a small shower mat or a complete bath set - you'll find the right thing for your personal oasis of well-being in the bathroom at home. For a modern look, you can choose from a variety of strong and subtle colours. You can easily cut the bath mats to your own personal dimensions, or to cut out corners, for example, using a cutting tool.
Easy-care and quick to clean
The fibres of the shower mat do not absorb dirt. Contaminants remain on the surface and can thus be easily removed with a hoover or a little water. Mould stains or mould growth do not occur, as moisture does not soak into the fibres of the bathroom rugs and the bathroom floor coverings dry again quickly as a result.

product.name: Aquarius Foundry 6 Column Horizontal Radiator in White -  600 X 1190
product.description:
The Aquarius Bathrooms Foundry 6 Column Horizontal Radiator delivers a substantial heating solution designed to establish a comforting presence at the heart of your home. With a 6 column arrangement, this horizontal radiator sits neatly beneath window frames or along principal walls to create an inviting focal point.

A white radiator is a versatile choice that sits in perfect harmony alongside the organic textures of wooden floors and soft woven fabrics. It blends seamlessly into gentle colour scheme, allowing the surrounding decorations to take centre stage. Alternatively, for homes with bold design choices, the angled aesthetics provides a striking geometric contrast against darker walls, adding a modern edge that coordinates beautifully with plush carpets and contemporary furnishings. This adaptability makes it a grounding piece that effortlessly ties an entire room together, regardless of how your personal style evolves over the years.

Why Choose a 6 Column Radiator?

A 6 column radiator is constructed with six distinct rows of vertical tubing engineered into every section. This creates an exceptionally deep, thick profile that packs a massive amount of metal surface area into a compact wall footprint.

By holding a significantly higher volume of hot water and metal mass, it offers an outstanding heat output capacity and accelerated warm up times. This makes it the premier choice for making expansive open plan family zones, grand hallways, high-ceiling conversions, or naturally drafty spaces feel genuinely cozy and snug.

Please note: This radiator operates on standard central heating networks. Radiator valves and legs are sold separately, giving you the creative freedom to select your own custom finishes to complete your space.

product.name: Anthracite Grey Sydney Designer Pre-Filled Electric Towel Rail Bathroom Radiator 500mm x 1200mm
product.description:
The Sydney 500mm x 1200mm Electric Bathroom Radiator in Anthracite combines a unique flat-panel design with a contemporary matte finish, making it a standout addition to any modern bathroom, kitchen, or cloakroom.

Design & Finish
Unique flat/straight steel construction with a matte Anthracite finish. Features a 15-tube layout that provides generous space for warming and airing towels. The extra-slim profile is engineered for restricted wall spaces without compromising on style or practicality.

Dimensions

Width: 500mm

Height: 1200mm

Pipe Centres: 100mm

Tube Dimension: 22mm

Wall to Pipe Centres: 55–95mm

Heat Output

1452 BTU/h

426W

What's Included

Adjustable square metal wall brackets (matching Anthracite)

Blanking plug

Air vent plug

400W electric element

Element Details
IP55 rated with a 1.5m flex cable attached. Operated via a wall switch (no built-in control). Supplied with both chrome and white covers for a clean finish.

Pre-Filled & Ready to Install
Arrives pre-filled with 85% pure water and 5% ethylene glycol anti-freeze, leaving a 10% air gap for safe expansion. The element is shipped separately and must be installed into the left or right bottom side. Once inserted, the radiator is ready to connect to electricity.

Quality & Certification
Tested to BS EN442 standards. 10 bar pressure tested for leaks. Triple layer finish for long-lasting durability. Manufactured in the EU (Not Far East).

Warranty
5 years on the radiator, 2 years on the heating element.

Suitable Rooms
Bathroom, Kitchen, Toilet, Cloakroom, Utility Room.

Aluminium Beaded Hose 45 Degree Elbow Connector for Silicone Hose Intercooler Boost Pipes (80mm OD)
product.description: 45° aluminium angle elbows provides a precision-engineered, high-performance solution for routing fluid or air hoses in tight or complex systems. Made from strong T6063 aluminium alloy, each bent tube features a smooth mirror-polished finish and consistent 1.6mm wall thickness. Standard leg length is 150mm (300mm overall), with a centreline radius matching common hose configurations. Available in a wide selection of outer diameters (from approx. 13mm up to 102mm) to suit standard hose line sizes. Ideal for coolant, intercooler, air intake, vacuum or water systems, these elbows deliver a compact, reliable 45° change of direction with minimal pressure drop. Built to withstand temperatures from −40°C to +220°C. They are lightweight for easy installation, compatible with silicone, rubber or plastic hose couplings, and engineered for corrosion resistance and optimal seal performance. These elbows are an excellent choice for professional workshops, DIY enthusiasts, and industrial applications where strength, precision and durability are required in confined spaces.

product.name: Aquarius Maxx Curved Single Panel Radiator in Matt Black - 1800 x 565mm
product.description:
The Aquarius Maxx Curved Vertical Single Panel Radiator is designed to provide effective heating while making practical use of wall space. With a fixed height of 1800mm and a choice of widths, it can be selected to suit different room sizes and heat requirements. White, anthracite, and black finishes are available to work across a wide range of interior styles.

The radiator incorporates curved front panels at the sides. On the far left and far right columns, the outer metal boundary sweeps backward toward the rear frame. This specific contour creates a softer transition between the front face of the radiator and the wall.

Manufactured from aluminium and designed for central heating systems, the Maxx radiator delivers rapid heat output and powerful performance when required.

Why Choose a Vertical Single Panel Design?

An upright radiator layout is highly effective at reclaiming valuable room space. By utilizing the height of your walls, you free up horizontal floor area, giving you more freedom to place furniture or clear busy walkways. Because this model uses a single row of panels, it maintains an incredibly low projection depth. It sits remarkably tight to the wall, making it an ideal choice for compact spots like kitchen alcoves, narrow hallway sections, or modern bathroom renovations.

Specifications and Sizes

 1800mm x 375mm: 2952 BTU | 35mm Wall To Pipe Centres
 1800mm x 470mm: 3691 BTU | 35mm Wall To Pipe Centres
 1800mm x 565mm: 4428 BTU | 35mm Wall To Pipe Centres
 1800mm x 660mm: 5166 BTU | 35mm Wall To Pipe Centres

Please note: This radiator operates on standard central heating networks. Radiator valves and legs are sold separately, giving you the creative freedom to select your own custom finishes to complete your space.

The Lifestyle image represents some of the specific sizes available. Check the cut-out image for the exact model and dimensions you are buying.

Available in White and Anthracite.

product.name: Aquarius Athens Single Vertical Column Radiator in White - 1800 x 300mm
product.description:
The Aquarius Bathrooms Athens Single Vertical Column Radiator offers a space saving heating design that complements a broad spectrum of interior styles. This vertical radiator utilizes an elegant row of smooth oval columns to guide the eye upward, making it an excellent choice for homes with limited horizontal wall space. The clean white finish functions as a beautiful neutral element, blending subtly into soft pastel or cream walls while providing a crisp contrast against deeper paint tones.

Engineered for central heating systems, this vertical radiator is constructed from high quality steel to ensure steady heat distribution across your living areas.

Why Choose a Single Layer Vertical Radiator?

This single layer vertical radiator features a single row of columns rather than a double layered layout. This construction gives the unit an exceptionally slim profile that projects minimally into your room.

It is the ideal configuration for narrow walkways, compact kitchens, or tight spaces behind doors. While it maintains a low profile footprint, its tall vertical height maximizes surface area to deliver excellent, reliable warmth to smaller or medium sized rooms.

Please note: Radiator valves are sold separately, allowing you the creative freedom to select your own custom valve shapes and finishes to complete your installation.

product.name: 54mm 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector White Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes

product.name: ProWarm 100W Premium Electric Underfloor Heating Mat (for Tile/Stone/Laminate/Wood) - 25m²
product.description:
Take the chill off tile, stone, laminate and engineered wood floors with ProWarm electrical underfloor heating. Designed for bathrooms, kitchens and living spaces, the pre-spaced mesh mat provides discreet, even warmth and can supplement or replace radiators when sized for room heat loss. Insulation and thermostat control help direct heat upwards and limit wasted energy. Roll out the mat, cut the mesh only to turn it, then spread flexible tile adhesive or pour self-levelling compound over the cable. Never cut the heating cable or fit it beneath fixed furniture. A 4 metre cold tail aids routing. A qualified electrician must connect the system. The cable has a lifetime manufacturer's warranty.

Choose from three wattages: 
100W for new-builds or secondary heating in older homes.
150W for primary heating in bathrooms, kitchens, and living areas.
200W for faster warm-up times and high heat loss areas.

product.name: Aluminium Hose Connector for Silicone Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes (40mm OD, 250mm Long)
product.description: This range of straight aluminium hose connectors provides a strong, lightweight, and corrosion-resistant solution for joining hoses in automotive, industrial, marine, and performance systems. Made from high-quality T6063 aluminium, each connector is engineered with a polished finish and consistent 1.6mm wall thickness, offering durability and a clean appearance. Available in a wide selection of outer diameters to suit standard hose sizes, these joiners are ideal for linking silicone, rubber, or plastic hoses in coolant systems, air intakes, vacuum lines, and oil or fuel setups. Whether you're building a custom engine bay or upgrading machinery, these connectors ensure a tight, efficient seal with minimal pressure drop. Easy to install, modify, or trim to length, they’re suitable for both professional workshops and home garages. Their compatibility with standard hoses makes them a versatile choice for long-lasting performance in harsh environments, withstanding extreme heat, vibration, and chemical exposure. A high-performance solution for anyone requiring precision connections in demanding systems.

product.description:

Measuring 150mm in width and available in various sizes in length, this tape is manufactured from durable 130-micron polypropylene, ensuring it withstands tough underground conditions.
Embedded within the tape are two stainless steel wires, allowing for easy detection from the surface using standard detection equipment. This ensures any underground service can be quickly and accurately located, providing added safety for workers and the public. The tape is highly visible in red and is printed with the warning message "CAUTION SEWER PIPE BELOW" to clearly indicate the nature of the service below. This colour-coding follows industry standards for underground marking tapes, ensuring compliance and recognition across various sites.
Compliant with EN 12613, this warning tape meets stringent safety and manufacturing standards, providing reliability and peace of mind on any project. Whether for new installations or maintenance work, this detectable tape helps avoid costly repairs and potential service interruptions, making it an essential tool for construction, civil engineering, and utility sectors. The durable design ensures the tape remains functional even in harsh environments.

product.name: FloPlast 135 Degree Solvent Weld Swivel Waste Bend - 40mm White - Pack of 2
product.description: 135° swivel bends create a tight-radius 45° change of direction in soil and waste systems. These spigot-to-socket solvent weld fittings have a long tail for insertion into another fitting and are supplied in a pack of two. Made from durable ABS, they are manufactured in the UK to BS EN 1455-1:2000 and are kitemarked. For solvent weld installation, clean pipe and fitting, apply SC250 solvent cement to both surfaces, push and twist fully home, wipe away excess and allow 12 hours before testing. Work in a well ventilated area and avoid skin contact with solvent cement. Solvent weld joints are permanent.

product.name: FloPlast 90 Degree Solvent Weld Swivel Waste Bend M&F, 40mm White - Pack of 2
product.description: Pack of two 40mm ABS swivel waste bends to create a compact 90° change of direction in domestic waste pipe systems. Commonly called M and F or spigot bends, each fitting has a long tail to insert into a socket for solvent-weld jointing. Manufactured in the UK to BS EN 1455-1:2000 and kitemarked. For solvent welding, ensure pipe and fitting are clean, apply SC250 solvent cement to both surfaces, push and twist fully home, wipe away excess and allow 5 minutes to set; leave 12 hours before testing. Solvent welds are permanent. Work in a well-ventilated area, keep cement away from heat and flames and avoid skin contact; wash with soap and water if contact occurs.

Manufactured with a multi-layer polyester braid reinforcement between inner and outer silicone layers, these hoses meet SAEJ20R3 standards for both automotive and industrial use. Operating in temperatures from -50°C to +220°C (with peaks up to +250°C), they’re ideal for coolant and heating systems. Available in diameters from 13mm up to 152mm and supplied in 1-metre lengths, each hose provides a smooth internal bore for optimal flow and easy fitment. With wall thicknesses of 4.5mm or 5.5mm depending on size, they offer working pressures up to 8.3 Bar and burst ratings up to 27 Bar. Whether you're upgrading a cooling system, managing engine bay airflow, or replacing worn components, these hoses combine flexibility, durability, and reliability in one robust package.

product.name: 30mm 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector Blue Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description: This 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector is a practical solution for creating smooth, angled connections between hoses. Manufactured from tough, lightweight ABS plastic, it offers excellent durability and resistance to weathering, corrosion, and everyday wear. The 45-degree design helps reduce hose stress while maintaining steady water flow, making it particularly useful in spaces where a gentle directional change is required. With its barbed ends, the connector ensures a firm grip on the hose, preventing leaks and slippage even when used under pressure. Perfect for use with garden hoses, pond hoses, aquarium setups, or general water systems, this connector supports efficient water management in both domestic and professional settings. Quick and easy to install, simply push the hose ends over the barbs to achieve a secure, watertight seal. Whether used in irrigation, pond filtration, or household water projects, it helps maintain neat and organised hose routing while protecting hoses from kinking. Combining reliability, strength, and ease of use, this connector is an essential accessory for gardeners, pond enthusiasts, and DIY users who need a cost-effective and long-lasting way to manage hose connections effectively.
